nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address of contract owner, set to deployer and mutable via transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
Hard-coded developer payout address 0xA0D0de1070948cF0CBD6Bdf4fB34D4D056bE7bC5 receiving 20% of the contract balance.
Base URI string used by _baseURI() for token metadata; writable by onlyOwner setBaseURI.
Public boolean gate; when true (default) anyone may call sex() even if not the owner.
Minimum ETH price required to call sex(); default 0.
Maximum boy sex price (1 ETH); set by setBaseSexPrice, unused in logic.
Minimum boy sex price; set by setBaseSexPrice, unused in logic.
Threshold (0-10000) compared against random(totalSupply()) to decide child gender.
Mapping tokenId => mother token id recorded in sex().
Mapping tokenId => father token id recorded in sex().
Declared mapping of boy sex prices; never written or read in logic.
Mapping tokenId => gender boolean derived from weak randomness in sex().
External DwarfsChilds contract reference used for father (boy) ownership lookups.
External DwarfsChilds contract reference used for mother (girl) ownership lookups.
ERC721 mapping owner => token count, incremented/decremented on mint/transfer/burn.
ERC721 mapping tokenId => owner address.
ERC721 mapping tokenId => approved operator address.
ERC721 nested mapping owner => operator => approved.
ERC721Enumerable array of all minted token ids; its length is totalSupply().
Declared market fee (0%); unused in logic.
Payable mint/breeding entry point: validates msg.value and parent ownership, stores parents, rolls random gender and _safeMint(_to, totalSupply()).
Payable onlyOwner wrapper that calls _withdrawAll() to distribute the contract balance.
Splits address(this).balance 20/80 and transfers to dev and _msgSender(); affected by tx.origin-independent caller identity, inherits no reentrancy guard.
Pseudo-random generator using block.difficulty and block.timestamp; predictable/weak randomness source.
onlyOwner setter for _baseTokenURI.
onlyOwner setter for baseSexPrice, MaxBoySexPrice and MinBoySexPrice.
onlyOwner setter toggling the sexEnable access gate.
onlyOwner setter for BabyBurthPercent; no upper bound enforced.
onlyOwner ownership transfer; rejects zero address.
onlyOwner internal function that sets _owner to address(0).
Access-control modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender().
View helper enumerating all token ids owned by an address.
View function forwarding tokensOfOwner to external DAW contract.
View function forwarding tokensOfOwner to external DWG contract.
View function returning stored gender, mother and father of a child token.
Internal ERC721 safe mint; mints then invokes _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
Internal mint updating _balances and _owners and emitting Transfer.
Internal transfer updating approvals, _balances and _owners.
Performs the IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received external callback when the recipient is a contract.
IERC721Receiver callback executed on the recipient during safe transfers/mints; attacker-controlled code.
Address library helper performing an unchecked-balance low-level recipient.call{value:amount}.
Address library low-level call{value} helper with isContract require and return-data bubbling.
msg.sender / _msgSender(): attacker-controlled caller used in sex(), onlyOwner, _withdrawAll and ERC721 checks.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value combined with block.difficulty in random().
payable(dev).transfer(balanceDev): fixed 2300-gas external send of the 20% developer cut.
payable(_msgSender()).transfer(balanceNftgangs): sends remaining balance to the caller of withdrawAll.
External staticcalls DWG.ownerOf(_mo) and DAW.ownerOf(_pa) inside sex(); their results gate minting.
_safeMint triggers an external onERC721Received callback on _to before/while sex() state is settled.
Low-level .call{value} in Address.sendValue/functionCallWithValue without reentrancy protection.
address(this).balance*20/100 and balance-balanceDev arithmetic splitting the withdrawal.
_to: recipient of the newly minted child in sex().
_mo: mother token id supplied to sex().
_pa: father token id supplied to sex().
_owner: address enumerated by tokensOfOwner().
_owner_: address forwarded to DAW.tokensOfOwner().
_owner_: address forwarded to DWG.tokensOfOwner().
_childid: token id queried by showGenderParents().
_COUNTER: totalSupply() seed for random().
_baseSexPrice: new sex price set by setBaseSexPrice.
_MaxBoySexPrice: new max boy price set by setBaseSexPrice.
_MinBoySexPrice: new min boy price set by setBaseSexPrice.
_sexEnable: new access gate value set by setSexEnable.
_BabyBurthPercent: new gender threshold set by setBabyBurthPercent.
newOwner: new owner address for transferOwnership.
baseURI: metadata base string passed to setBaseURI/constructor.
balanceDev: computed 20% developer share in _withdrawAll.
balanceNftgangs: remaining 80% balance forwarded to _msgSender().
msgSender: cached _msgSender() stored as _owner in the Ownable constructor.

edges.reason: sex() gate is require(msg.sender == _owner || sexEnable) and sexEnable defaults to true, so any msg.sender can mint without ownership.
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender(), the only real access control in the contract.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable to authorize the caller.
withdrawAll() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseURI() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBaseSexPrice() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setSexEnable() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBabyBurthPercent() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership() is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
_withdrawAll() pays the remaining balance directly to _msgSender().
random() derives its seed from block.timestamp (and block.difficulty), making the result miner-influenceable.
_COUNTER (totalSupply()) is multiplied into the random gender computation.
sex() passes totalSupply() as the _COUNTER argument to random().
The random gender value is compared with BabyBurthPercent inside sex() to set _sex.
The withdrawAll caller is the recipient of the 80% transfer.
withdrawAll() delegates all fund movement to _withdrawAll().
_withdrawAll computes the 20/80 split with balance*20/100 arithmetic.
_withdrawAll sends balanceDev to the hard-coded dev address via transfer().
_withdrawAll performs an external send to _msgSender() with no reentrancy guard.
The dev transfer sends funds to the dev state variable address.
sex() calls DWG.ownerOf and DAW.ownerOf to verify parent ownership.
DWG state reference supplies the mother-ownership lookup target.
DAW state reference supplies the father-ownership lookup target.
sex() calls _safeMint, which invokes the recipient's onERC721Received before the transaction completes.
A malicious _to contract can re-enter sex() from its onERC721Received callback during _safeMint.
Address.sendValue performs an external low-level call{value} that can re-enter the caller.
functionCallWithValue forwards value through target.call(data) with no reentrancy protection.
_to is used as the mint recipient in sex().
_mo is written into _mothers at the new token id.
_pa is written into _fathers at the new token id.
_mo is passed to DWG.ownerOf for the mother ownership check.
_pa is passed to DAW.ownerOf for the father ownership check.
balanceDev holds the computed 20% dev share.
balanceNftgangs holds the remaining 80% of the balance.
balanceDev is the amount transferred to dev.
balanceNftgangs is the amount transferred to _msgSender().
sex() mints the child with _safeMint(_to, totalSupply()).
_to flows into _safeMint as the new token owner.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
_safeMint delegates the actual state mutation to _mint.
_mint increments _balances[to] and thus mutates the balance mapping.
_mint writes the new owner into _owners[tokenId].
_transfer decrements _balances[from] and increments _balances[to].
_transfer rewrites _owners[tokenId] to the new owner.
_transfer clears the previous approval via _approve(address(0), tokenId).
sex() records _mothers[totalSupply()] = _mo.
sex() records _fathers[totalSupply()] = _pa.
sex() writes the random gender result into _sex[totalSupply()].
sex() compares the random value against BabyBurthPercent.
sex() reads sexEnable to decide whether caller identity matters.
baseURI argument is written into _baseTokenURI.
setBaseURI stores the new metadata base into _baseTokenURI.
Constructor baseURI is forwarded to _baseTokenURI through setBaseURI.
showGenderParents reads _sex for the child id.
showGenderParents reads _mothers for the child id.
showGenderParents reads _fathers for the child id.
_childid selects which stored parent/gender values are returned.
_baseSexPrice argument is assigned to baseSexPrice.
_MaxBoySexPrice argument is assigned to MaxBoySexPrice.
_MinBoySexPrice argument is assigned to MinBoySexPrice.
setBaseSexPrice updates baseSexPrice.
setBaseSexPrice updates MaxBoySexPrice.
setBaseSexPrice updates MinBoySexPrice.
sex() requires msg.value >= baseSexPrice for non-owner callers.
_sexEnable argument is assigned to the sexEnable gate.
setSexEnable can open or close the sex() gate, affecting who may mint.
_BabyBurthPercent argument is assigned with no upper bound check.
setBabyBurthPercent overwrites the gender threshold used with random().
newOwner argument becomes the new privileged _owner.
transferOwnership writes _owner, handing over all onlyOwner privileges.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), permanently disabling onlyOwner functions.
_owner argument is enumerated for token balances and indices.
_owner_ argument is forwarded to the external DAW.tokensOfOwner call.
DAWview performs an external call on the DAW contract reference.
_owner_ argument is forwarded to the external DWG.tokensOfOwner call.
DWGview performs an external call on the DWG contract reference.
The constructor caches _msgSender() in msgSender and assigns it to _owner.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used as the mint recipient inside sex(); merge the parameter into sex().
_mo only flows into _mothers and DWG.ownerOf within sex(); merge into sex().
_pa only flows into _fathers and DAW.ownerOf within sex(); merge into sex().
_owner is the sole argument of tokensOfOwner(); merge into that function.
_owner_ is the sole argument forwarded by DAWview(); merge into DAWview().
_owner_ is the sole argument forwarded by DWGview(); merge into DWGview().
_childid only selects storage slots read by showGenderParents(); merge into it.
_COUNTER is the only input of random(); merge into random().
_baseSexPrice is assigned to state in setBaseSexPrice(); merge into that setter.
_MaxBoySexPrice is assigned to state in setBaseSexPrice(); merge into that setter.
_MinBoySexPrice is assigned to state in setBaseSexPrice(); merge into that setter.
_sexEnable is assigned to the gate in setSexEnable(); merge into that setter.
_BabyBurthPercent is assigned to state in setBabyBurthPercent(); merge into that setter.
newOwner is the ownership target of transferOwnership(); merge into it.
baseURI is written to _baseTokenURI via setBaseURI(); merge into setBaseURI().
balanceDev is a transient result of the 20% split arithmetic; merge into that unsafe operation.
balanceNftgangs is a transient result of the balance split arithmetic; merge into that unsafe operation.
